Hi Sarah — really appreciate the quick follow-up and the PO. We’re keen to run the pilot with HelioMed. A few pragmatic items from our side to keep things smooth:

1) For an initial 90-day pilot we typically offer either:
   • Net30 with a 15% escrow holdback for the pilot period, or
   • Net45 with a reduced escrow (10%) and a capped provisional credit line

2) We can accept consolidated monthly invoices and a PO match.

3) Before we can commit a provisional credit line we’ll need a completed credit application and the most recent Accounts Payable remit/contact. If you prefer, we can also set up an ACH mandate to shorten settlement timelines.

Proposed middle ground: Net45 for the pilot, provisional credit cap of USD 150,000, 10% escrow holdback applied to invoice value during the pilot. At the end of the 90 days we will reconcile usage and either refund escrow or apply against outstanding invoices; if metrics look good we will convert to your preferred net60 or a non-escrowed arrangement.

I’m looping Ben (Finance) and Naomi (AR Ops) to confirm feasibility and to move the credit paperwork. If that sounds reasonable, I’ll send the credit app and an escrow template for legal review.

Best,
